title: 【うんちく】恐竜が絶滅した日、季節はいつ？ #Shorts
description:
答えは、北半球の春。手がかりは、魚の骨に残る季節の線と、エラに入ったままの隕石のガラスの粒です。

アプリ「ヒトへの46億年」（地球と生命の歴史）に関係する話です。

アプリ: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/evolution/

しし屋 まなびラボ（ほかのアプリ）: https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/

出どころ: During ほか (2022) Nature 603, 91–94。化石はアメリカ・ノースダコタ州タニスの1か所で、隕石の日と結びつけることを疑う研究者もいます。「南が生きのこりやすかった」は著者の仮説です。図は形のイメージです。

en.title: Did you know? What season it was when the dinosaurs died #Shorts
en.description:
The answer: spring, in the Northern Hemisphere. The clues are seasonal lines in fish bones and glass beads from the impact still stuck in their gills. Turn on English subtitles (CC).

Related to the app "4.6 Billion Years to Us" (the history of Earth and life).

App (switch to English with the EN button): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/evolution/

Shishiya Manabi Lab (more apps): https://sishiya.github.io/manabi-lab/?lang=en

Sources: During et al. (2022) Nature 603, 91-94. The fossils come from one site, Tanis in North Dakota, and some researchers doubt the link to the impact day. "Southern life survived more easily" is the authors' hypothesis. Drawings are illustrative.
